study type: Register-based cohort study with sibling comparison
cohort: The study population comprised 779,711 children born in Sweden between 2005-2012, identified from national health registers.
finding: Severe pre-eclampsia, but not mild/moderate, is associated with childhood asthma, including non-allergic prevalent asthma at 6 years, regardless of familial factors and confounders.
cross-section timing: Prevalent allergic and non-allergic asthma was assessed at 6 years of age.
